setup.description: Install and verify macports-rs, select its version, and publish its environment for subsequent tasks.

version.description: Tool release or supported channel to install; omitted values use the documented default.

installDir.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

packageName.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

sudo.description: Use noninteractive sudo for requested port installs; setup-macports also uses it for its system installer. The macports-rs CLI itself is always installed without sudo.

packages.description: Comma-separated MacPorts port names to install, such as git,cmake,python312; omit or leave blank for CLI-only setup. Package versions come from the configured ports tree.
